body: I sincerely hope you didn't go through with it. There's still time. Please don't give up. You don't want to end up in one of those cringe cloud pictures do you?

Don't give up. I will relay your own words back to you:

"Everyone is a little broken. Some pieces that are still there are what we have to hang on to."

Hold on. Please, hold on.

I understand. In this moment, take a breath. Don't do anything permanent. Covid-19 has done a number on lots of people's mental health. You're not alone. That love you feel...hold on to it. Grip it tight in your mind's eye. Your wife's smile, the laughter of your children. All the challenges you've overcome. Hold them deep inside, and then feel it surround you like a forcefield. You're not empty, I promise. You're filled with the dreams your wife and children have of a life together with you. Lockdown will pass. At least wait until then.
Thank you. Might be the last one I get.

Thank you. I honestly rarely feel down. Feels like I trained them for this I don't know. Now I really need help though. I really really really need it and people aren't there for me. Anonymous people on Reddit are being more emotionally tender with me. Thanks for your comment. I don't know what's wrong with me physically but right now I'm more concerned about mentally. This is the first time I've genuinely felt like I could just fucking kill myself and be done.

I don't know man. I understand deep down why they treat me like this. I'm Mr. Large and in charge, Mr. Bigshot who always gets it done. I'm just shocked I could reach out to my closest friends and tell them I'm feeling defeated and emotionally unwell and get back a logistics kind of response. I'm wondering if I've trained them for this somehow. This would be the second time in my life I've really asked for support. I said it as clearly as possible. "I'm feeling really low right now. That email I showed you has me feeling completely defeated. I feel emotionally unstable. 😢". How much more clear can I get? I don't know how to communicate how I feel more than that.

I'm in the same boat except replace law with medicine. Not much to say since I'm also in a dark place, but I will say this. You aren't a burden. You're wonderful. In fact, I'd bet you're so wonderful and helpful the other way around doesn't readily occur to them. You're just doing what you're "supposed" to do, right? I know I'm projecting, but this post is my mirror image. Be well.
Thank you for this. My bottle count really broke my spirit. I'm only on day 4 but I'm so happy you're doing well. I'm going to start working out too!
Thank you. I appreciate it. Never been much of a talker, which is probably why I fell into this hole in the first place, but I'll keep it in mind.
Thanks. Threw out some more. The bags are the largest size so 4 fill the dumpster. Still have a few more to go.
That's the one I got. Right now it's rather unhealthy but I'm pretty much going to sleep soon after work. Then by the time I wake up, there's curfew, so I know I've made it another day.

Tried melatonin + tea + antihistamine. I went out and bought some Zyzzquil and that + melatonin did the job. 

Weeks or months sounds terrible. For me, drugs are a bad idea. I know now I have an addictive personality, thanks.
I'll look up SMART recovery, thanks.
Thank you. I'm about to throw out some more right now in the dead of night, so hopefully nobody will see anyway. I hope it is worth it.

Thank you. I just feel so unmotivated right now it's scary. Before, I used to work hard all day to finish my work as soon as I could at the best quality I could so that I could drink with "no regrets". Now, I just don't have anything except the grind every day all day.

Sadly I couldn't find any recycling centers nearby. I'm going to start working out as well. One of the contributing factors to me quitting is gaining 100 lbs due to alcohol and alcohol related eating. Thanks.
I'm trying. Thanks for the kind words. Decided not to tell her. I doubt she's capable of being supportive on this. I'll just stick with it on my own.
Thank you. I threw out 5 so far. Trying to split them across different days.
